cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Assigned by Procedure
cards.instruction: Get someone to accept an unwanted responsibility by proving that the rules, rotation, or tradition make it theirs.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Congratulations on becoming club president. Here are the toilet keys.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought the caretaker cleaned them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. We voted to save that fee. The minutes assign closing and cleaning to the president.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I proposed that when you were president.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, and I cleaned them all year. Your first presidential duty is continuing your savings.

mechanism: A welcomes its former pupil as club president by teaching the cleaning duty that the pupil own prior savings rule now assigns to that office.
confusable: Not revenge unsupported by rules: the voted minutes assign the responsibility to whoever holds the role, including A before B.
comparison: Rota duration versus role succession under a pupil-authored rule.
